description: Check whether a domain name is for sale and what it costs, across several extensions in one call: for each domain, its availability ('available' to register, 'taken', 'aftermarket' for sale, 'expiring') and, when listed for sale, the asking price in US dollars and the marketplace. Use when the user asks if a domain is available, for sale, or what it costs: 'is cova.com for sale?', 'price for cinch.com', 'check acme in .io and .co'. Also checks .com, .net, .org and .ai unless the user names other extensions, so mention any of those that are for sale. This is the current listing price, not an appraisal (use get_domain_value for what a domain is worth) and not ownership (use get_domain_info). Each name shows only its lowest-priced listing. A for-sale domain with no price_usd is listed without an asking price. Whether a listing is buy now, make offer or auction is not known, so do not guess. Registration fees for available domains are not included.

domain.description: The name to price, with or without an extension, e.g. "cova.com" or "cova". A full URL is accepted. Its own extension is always checked.

tlds.description: Other extensions to check, without the dot, e.g. ["io", "co"]. Omit unless the user names other extensions: the default checks com, net, org and ai alongside the domain's own. Up to 20.

name: get_domain_prices
title: Check domain prices
